candidates.change_summary: Return address(0) instead of the stored _owner, so any call to owner() returns the zero address whenever the owner is set.
Return msg.sender instead of _owner, so owner() returns the caller's address rather than the stored owner (differing for any non-owner caller, or after renounceOwnership).
Return tx.origin instead of _owner, so owner() returns the transaction originator instead of the stored owner, which differs whenever the call is made via an intermediary.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can execute transferOwnership and change the owner.
Remove the zero-address check so the owner can be transferred to address(0), making owner() return address(0).
Remove the actual ownership transfer so owner() still returns the previous owner after a call to transferOwnership.
Remove the assignment to rewardDistributor so the setter no longer changes the stored distributor address.
Assign msg.sender instead of the supplied _distributor parameter.
Assign the zero address instead of the supplied _distributor parameter.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call setRewardDistributor and change rewardDistributor.
Assign msg.sender to migrator instead of the _migrator parameter.
Assign the zero address to migrator instead of the _migrator parameter.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can set the migrator.
Remove the ownership check inside onlyOwner so setMigrator can be called by anyone.
